newsitem.title: USA: China poultry talks productive -- U.S. official.
newsitem.headline: China poultry talks productive -- U.S. official.

text.p: U.S. officials have returned to Washington after productive talks in Beijing on a Chinese threat to block trade in poultry from 10 U.S. states, a senior official said Monday.
Paul Drazek, senior trade advisor at the U.S. Department of Agriculture, said U.S. and Chinese officials were pleased with the outcome of the talks.
Drazek, who was speaking on USDA radio, did not specify if any agreement had been reached at the meetings last week and said there would be ongoing discussions.
Despite the threatened disruption, U.S. poultry exports continue to flow to China uninterrupted, Drazek said.
China said last month it was banning imports of live poultry and poultry meat from 10 U.S. states because of fears over avian influenza.
